_comment: Offline harness for cortex.lab:php2shell-session-lfi-rce. Order matters: the control response is matched BEFORE the readback, because the control's session file name contains the same sid. commandEcho reflects the engine challenge nonce carried in the query string.

responses._comment: The include route really includes files - the gate the rule needs before it runs the chain.
Negative control first: session file does not exist, so the include yields no command output.
Readback: the session file was included and its payload ran - echo <nonce>; id.
Upload: PHP's upload_progress handler stores the filename; the app itself returns JSON.
